_note: Every fixed sentence the overlay shows. tests/test_verifier.py runs each through the Verifier, with sample values for the placeholders.
tagline: Each player's hard running, and the short-term battery expected for a typical pro
disclaimer: Synthetic match. The battery is the short-term reserve we expect a typical pro to have left after the same running; it drains in hard runs and refills when walking or jogging. It is an estimate and does not show how tired the players actually are.
battery: Short-term battery: about {pct}%, expected for a typical pro after {name}'s running so far.
band: Our estimate, with a 10–90% band of {lo}–{hi}% of a typical professional's short-term reserve, because his own fitness is unknown.
lowChance: A typical professional would be below half their short-term reserve after running like this {chance} of the time, by our calibrated estimate.
legendBattery: Short-term battery: expected for a typical pro after the same running (drains in hard runs, refills when walking or jogging)
batteriesSome: Batteries: the selected player (tick for all)
legendFlatOut: Flat out: a run at 90% or more of his top speed so far
redZone: These are {name}'s hardest minutes so far: his high-speed running at its peak.
postPeak: Just after {name}'s hardest minutes so far.
offPitch: {name} is not on the pitch at this point.
topSpeed: {name}'s fastest second so far: {v} m/s ({kmh} km/h).
teamChartSub: Metres each team's outfield players ran above 5.5 m/s (19.8 km/h), per minute the ball was in play; one point for every 5 minutes of the match.
traceBattery: {name}: short-term battery expected for a typical pro after the same running, with its 10–90% band
traceBatteryAxis: % of a typical professional's short-term reserve left
traceHsr: {name}: metres run above 5.5 m/s (19.8 km/h) in the last minute
hlSub: The top 3 so far, one per player. Click one to watch it at normal speed.
blocked: Lines the Verifier blocked, with the rule they broke; they never reach the screen.
legendFocus: The player the explanation is about
legendRedZone: Hardest minutes: his high-speed running at its peak so far
upNext: All the clips, in match order
speedChartSub: 1-s mean speed from the tracking. Dashed: 5.5 m/s (19.8 km/h), where high-speed running starts. Shaded: his high-speed runs.
distanceChartSub: Metres covered, added up second by second from the tracking.
chartHint: Hover for values; click to jump there.
cmpTopSpeed: Average match top speed for his position
cmpGap: Usual gap between high-speed runs for his position
cmpGround: Premier League average for his position group
hlChecked: Measured; checked by the Verifier's rules
match_story: Story match: generated with a high press
splitChartSub: Metres each team's outfield players ran above 5.5 m/s (19.8 km/h) per minute of each situation, ball in play only. The situations come from who had the ball and where it was.
splitAxis: m per minute of that situation (under each: minutes of ball in play, both teams)
splitShare: {team}: {share}% of their high-speed running came in the first 10 s after the ball changed hands, in {time}% of the time the ball was in play.
splitHover: {team}, {situation}: {rate} m of high-speed running per minute of it; {share}% of their high-speed running came in it, in {time}% of the time the ball was in play.
sit_after_losing: First 10 s after losing the ball
sit_on_ball: On the ball, after those 10 s
sit_off_ball_high: Without the ball, ball in the opponents' third
ltBatterySub: Short-term battery expected for a typical pro
ltBand: Our estimate: {lo}–{hi}% of a typical professional's short-term reserve, the 10–90% band, because his own fitness is unknown.
sheetSub: The short-term battery expected for a typical pro after each player's running so far; it drains in hard runs and refills when walking or jogging. Click a name to follow him.
allBlocked: All lines the Verifier blocked in this match ({n})
detailsWait: This clip's details open when it ends.
checkedBy: Pipeline: Tactical → Narrator → Personalization → Verifier ({stage}), on Microsoft Foundry (Agent Framework)
checkedByTemplate: Pipeline: Tactical → Personalization → Template → Verifier ({stage}), with Microsoft Agent Framework
mcpPlayer: Read-only MCP tools: moment finder, player signals, moment context, claims register, verifier
mcpTeam: Read-only MCP tools: moment finder, team running, claims register, verifier
feedEmpty: The first explanation comes with the first moment. Start the match or pick a moment.
clickPlayer: Click a player on the pitch, or a name in the team sheet.
loadError: Could not load the match; reload the page to try again.
pitchLabel: The synthetic match, seen from above
traceTip: Short-term battery expected for a typical pro: {pct}% ({lo}–{hi}%)
traceTipFan: Short-term battery expected for a typical pro: {pct}%
traceLowTip: Below half their short-term reserve: {chance} of the time, by our estimate
traceHint: Hover a chart for values; click to jump there. Shaded: his hardest minutes. Dashed: half-time.
teamChartHint: Hover for values; click to jump there. Dashed: half-time.
ltTeamRunning: m per minute in play above 5.5 m/s (19.8 km/h), {block}
legendGap: Faded player: the tracking lost him for a moment, so he is drawn between where it last and next saw him
about_red_zone: His hardest minutes so far: his high-speed running over 1, 2 or 5 minutes is near his best of the match and near the published peak for professionals.
about_exposed_on_turnover: His team lost the ball during or just after his hardest minutes so far. The clip follows the opponents' attack, which came his way or ended in a shot.
about_second_wind: His high-speed running is back to his match average within 10 minutes of his hardest minutes. The clip shows his longest run in the 2 minutes before.
about_fresh_legs: A substitute's high-speed running per minute in his first 10 minutes, against the player he replaced. The clip shows his longest high-speed run in that time.
about_not_tired_tactical: His running dropped at a time when the score, a stoppage, possession or the start of a half explains it.
about_tug_of_war: One team's high-speed running per ball-in-play minute over 15 minutes, against the other team's.
about_flat_out: A run at 90% or more of his top speed so far in the match.
